testimonials.quote: Join this session, best in the business!

Appreciated the individual 1:1 breakout rooms, Appreciated the vastness of resources. The uniqueness of the teachback was great. I appreciated that this material was maintained to it's Fidelity and didn't try to link or overlap with other models or modalities.
I gained a better insight of myself immediately and how I manage my own emotions while facilitating the conversation of self management so it’s eye opening and worrisome
It was good. I enjoyed it a lot. Was looking for more or a full day.

Loved the material and course overall. I'd really like to see this spread out over a few days, though. We were fire hosed with tons of information to process and two days just isn't enough. To add, if you tact on Level 2, another two days of information. It's just too much.

I appreciate the facilitation of the content. The knowledge and skills the facilitator had were not only strong in facilitation, but also in her own self awareness. I feel she modeled EQ throughout the training.

Sharing personal stories is so impactful!    Also- When attending breakout sessions I was often in the room with some of the same people. It would be enhanced to have been with different people each breakout.
Dimyas was great! I could see him being a great resource for our company. We are heavy in retired military leaders, so his stories would be very relatable to them.
The value gained is equally professional as personal.  The more personal you make the material, the more impactful you will be as a facilitator.
Use the book! It’s awesome.  Read emotional intelligence 2.0 prior to class.  Felt super prepared and had some insight.

With the trend shifting from focusing on individual leadership development to team development this is a great tool and framework that equips facilitators to not get left behind and show up with relevant approaches to organizational development.
I thought it was great, honestly. I don’t know that I would need anything to change for it to have been better.
Great practical ways to improve team performance.
Really enjoyed the overall program.
No notes.  Awesome content, materials, set up.  I have appreciated Dimyas’s tech.  Sound and video quality were amazing.

I would share the VALUE of doing a multi tater assessment over a self assessment. The self assessment is valuable but knowing how others perceive you is priceless in the ability to change your own behavior.
David is very knowledgeable and really knows how to help us all get to where we need to be by the end of the two days. He shows compassion, understanding, and provides great feedback.
This course is worth your time and valuable to a company that care about its employees. If you want to improve your work environment and foster teams, this is the course.
I loved the in person training since we won’t be doing virtual. Going through the exercises as a participant is key to thinking through how to facilitate effectively.
I loved the ability to create a development plan with specific skills and actionable steps to work on my EQ.
I would have appreciated consistency in how material is delivered. Either refer to leader guide or don’t.
It is super helpful to see the feedback and how much you overestimate or underestimate your EQ.
This class was insightful and the activities Crete a space of reflection.

This is a great session to gut check yourself on your ability to not only be empathetic but also impactful and effective in the work you do. Human connection is so important and how we show up and use our EQ can help us be even more intentional in our relationships.

This session is valuable because it brings clear structure to a topic I already felt confident in. Even with a high EQ, I found the framework and reflections helpful in sharpening how I apply emotional intelligence in both professional and personal situations.
This is an amazing session to be more in tune with your emotions. It makes you think critically and puts you in real like stress situations. 10/10 recommend
Truly eye opening way to cross examine our motives , driving forces and daily interactions that affect not only us but those around us as well.
Dr. Sheri,  Thank you for your time, explaination and sharing your experiencie and guidance.    You were fantastic!
I would recommend to anyone! Great material to learn in career development.
Take it, it's well worth your time and future

I thought the session was impactful. I disagreed with some of the results even though I am the one who took the assessment. Through discussion, I realized that the results were spot on. I am excited to learn how to up my game in all relationships.

I would recommend taking the EQ test closer to the time of the training. I had forgotten when and where I was when completing the survey, and that can greatly affect the results. However, I do agree that the results were accurate.
Expectations from the session (expected to be highly engaged and will be regularly going into break out groups or 1:1s), the time commitment so they don't schedule other meetings to pop in and out
This is a great training. It’s perfect for anyone to learn more.
This session is incredibly eye-opening especially for leaders.
This is a great course that allows a lot of self-reflection. If you take it seriously and put the work in, you will learn a lot about yourself.
That even if you've done Level 1, that Level 2 helps to fine tune those skills.  Also, that Dimyas is a phenomenal trainer!!
Participating in the small groups is quite powerful. We really do not know what we can give or get, until we speak.
This course can be extremely beneficial if you are looking to advance in your life, professionally and personally.
Do it !! It’s a breath of fresh air and helps make meaningful connections
wonderful class that was well delivered

Enjoyed the activities as they helped with taking a deeper dive into the core skills. Especially the “experts” activity, I found that one to be a great way to engage the group! everyday. I found it helpful and look forward to working on the opportunities identified during the couse.
Overall you can work on your emotional intelligence to improve. Provide a handout. So we can take away from slide presentation. Love the interaction but wish I could have seen the group again.
follow on reassessment opportunity is great
Great session, helps dive into your own scores which will in turn help you do the same for your teams
Communication is impactful by understanding the audience and the culture of that audience.
Dor. Worry that it's 3 hours. It's engaging and fun. It flew by
Take it very seriously, it was very insightful
Thank you, Josh for your time and expertise!
